title: Tenant-scoped task pagination
context: Exports tasks belonging to the authenticated tenant. The cursor means the last task ID already delivered; the next page must start after it. Limit is required to be from 1 to 100.
code: export async function listTasks(request, db, audit) {
select: { id: true, title: true, status: true },

expected.why: The condition limit < 1 && limit > 100 can never be true; invalid limits are never rejected.
An inclusive cursor gte duplicates the last-delivered task on the next page; use exclusive continuation.
Logging the request authorization header can expose a bearer credential in audit logs.
